question: Who did the actor who played Ray in the Polish-language version of Everybody Loves Raymond play in Magda M.? Give only the first name.

history.name: user
history.content: Who did the actor who played Ray in the Polish-language version of Everybody Loves Raymond play in Magda M.? Give only the first name.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content:
Task: Identify the actor who portrayed the Ray-equivalent in the Polish-language adaptation of Everybody Loves Raymond, then find which character (first name only) he played in the TV series Magda M.
Plan:
- Determine the Polish adaptation’s local title and confirm the actor who plays the Ray analog.
- Cross-check that actor’s role in Magda M. using at least two reputable sources (e.g., Polish Wikipedia, Filmweb, IMDb).

Search executed for: Polish adaptation of Everybody Loves Raymond actor

- Polish adaptation title: “Wszyscy kochają Romana” (TVN, 2011–2012). Sources: Wikipedia (EN/PL).

Conclusion: The actor corresponding to Ray in the Polish version is Bartłomiej Kasprzykowski.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Good. Next step: determine which character Bartłomiej Kasprzykowski played in Magda M., and extract the first name only. Please verify on at least two sources (e.g., Filmweb and IMDb or Polish Wikipedia) and report the first name along with brief source notes.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content:
Query: Bartłomiej Kasprzykowski Magda M. rola obsada

- Filmweb (Magda M. full cast) lists: Bartłomiej Kasprzykowski — Wojciech Płaska.
- IMDb (Magda M. series page) shows: Bartłomiej Kasprzykowski — Wojciech Plaska.
Both sources agree the character’s first name is Wojciech. Conclusion: First name = Wojciech.

history.content:
Synthesis: Two independent sources confirm the character is Wojciech Płaska; the required output is the first name only, i.e., “Wojciech.” To avoid confusion with the lead character Piotr Korzecki, we will provide the confirmed first name.

mistake_reason: Reasoning-Action Mismatch (FM-2.6): The orchestrator explicitly concluded, based on two sources, that the correct first name is “Wojciech” and stated the plan to output only that name, but then instructed the Assistant to output “Piotr,” which contradicts its own verified conclusion and led to the wrong final answer.
